source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free faceted perfume bottle, one blank oval label panel, one short neck with stepped stopper, one hose, and one ribbed squeeze bulb in a stable three-quarter view. No brand text, decorative border, or poster treatment.

process_strategy: Reserve the entire bottle, blank label, neck, stopper, hose, bulb, highlights, facets, and shadow in pale construction; build every later contour and fill on those same footprints; and restrict the final panel to cleanup of established outlines, marker fills, highlights, and shadow.

final_elements.description: A squat faceted bottle envelope in three-quarter view with a reserved blank oval label, short neck, stepped stopper, C-curved hose, ribbed squeeze bulb, two highlight routes, and one broken shadow.

final_elements.name: faceted bottle blank label neck and stepped stopper contours
final_elements.description: The glass bottle silhouette, shoulder facets, blank oval label panel, short neck, and stepped stopper wrap the original construction without changing pose or scale.

final_elements.name: single curved hose ribbed squeeze bulb highlights and shadow
final_elements.description: One hose curves from the stopper to one ribbed bulb, with two slim bottle highlights and one broken grounding shadow established before ink or color.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip contours facets and bulb ribs
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces the established bottle, label, stopper, hose, bulb, facet, highlight, and shadow contours with imperfect line weight.

final_elements.name: raspberry teal mustard and navy marker fills
final_elements.description: Raspberry perfume glass, a teal blank label, mustard stopper and bulb, and navy hose and shadow fill the reserved shapes with visible marker streaks.

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free perfume bottle, one three-quarter view, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep exactly one blank label, one stopper, one hose, one squeeze bulb, two highlights, and one shadow after those routes appear.
No bottle facet may cross the blank label, no hose may cross the bottle, and no shadow may cross the bottle or bulb silhouettes.
Do not add eyes, a mouth, limbs, words, brand marks, extra bottles, flowers, a vanity scene, sticker outlines, badge frames, arrows, labels, numbers, signatures, or watermarks.
The final panel may not introduce a bottle edge, label, stopper tier, hose bend, bulb rib, facet, highlight, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean icon art, polished AI poster rendering, or glossy product advertising.
